error.message: Nothing was posted. On this computer a Microsoft Store app's package, such as <desktop client> Desktop installed from the Microsoft Store, keeps a second copy of ComplyEaze Bridge's data folder, and that copy holds, or may hold, an import journal of its own. Neither copy's checks see the other's batches, so a row posted from here could be posted again from there. Post from the Store app's copy instead (the assistant inside <desktop client> Desktop, when the package is <desktop client> Desktop's). That copy does not see this saved Journal or anything posted from here, so check its rows in Tally before posting them there. Do not move or delete either folder.

The journal checks of one copy do not see the batches of the other, so a row posted from one could be posted again from the other. The cause says what was found: other_journal_holds_batches, or other_journal_not_read, package_copies_not_listed, journal_not_located or package_copy_journal_not_located when ComplyEaze Bridge could not tell and refuses the same way. Tell the user to post from the copy that already keeps that journal (the extension inside <desktop client> Desktop, when the package is <desktop client> Desktop's), not from this one, and not to move, merge or delete either folder. Batches this copy already built or posted are not seen by that copy, so a row posted from here could be posted again from there; check such a row in Tally before posting it there. Uninstalling, resetting or repairing that Microsoft Store app removes its copy and the journal in it. Running bridge_mcp --local-data-report --show-paths outside <desktop client> Desktop lists the package copies (package_copies). Do not retry here.
